audit.whatIsWrong: The whys are shifted one stage early: the Level 3 slot describes Levels 4-5, the Levels 4-5 slot describes Level 6, and the Level 6 slot describes the first-item spike. The chart then gives Gwen Level 3 and Levels 4-5 — the exact window the spike text calls 'your sore spot' — and gives her 2+ items, which the same page hands to Lillia.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is the pivot. Before it, a melee cannot pin a champion whose whole kit is move speed; after it, Gwen wins. The stages had to be realigned to what the text already says.
audit.corrected: whys[2] through whys[6] re-slotted to their real stages, and the chart set to Lillia / Skill / Skill / Lillia / Gwen / Gwen / Lillia.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Bait or sidestep her R' with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110s — the longest cooldown in the matchup. A dodged R at level 6 buys 150 seconds, which is why the level-6 spike and the first-item spike are the same window.
audit.corrected: R, Q (6s) and Swirlseed (a flat 12s) cooldowns added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Blooming Blows is treated as generic poke; nothing says its outer edge deals TRUE damage.
audit.why: Riot's text: Blooming Blows deals magic damage nearby and extra true damage on the edge. Stacking MR does nothing against the rim, and the rim is where a kiting Lillia wants you — this is the one interaction that changes how you space against her.
audit.corrected: Stated in Key Ability Interactions and the level 4-5 spike.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are her window over you: you have no untargetability yet, she kites your melee with move speed and stacks passive DOT before you ever reach mist range.
edits.after: Q+E online and you can punish a step-up, but with no mist yet she just walks away on stacked move speed — hold even and take the CS you are given.

edits.before: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist online flips it: drop mist as her R sleep or Q lands so the burst whiffs, then snip her while untargetable from outside the cloud.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are her window: you have no untargetability yet, so she kites your melee with stacked move speed and piles on passive DOT before you ever reach mist range.

edits.before: Riftmaker/Nashor's is your peak: %max-HP Q, heal-on-damage, and E's on-hit range out-duel her passive DOT in any extended fight you can force.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist flips it: drop mist as Lilting Lullaby (150s) or her Q lands so the burst whiffs, then snip her from untargetable.

edits.before: Inside your mist a clean 1v1 is still yours: she's squishy, your E refunds to stay on her, and the true-damage center of Q ignores any MR she buys.
edits.after: Riftmaker/Nashor's is your peak: %max-HP Q, heal-on-damage, and E's on-hit range out-duel her passive DOT in any fight you can force.

edits.before: She out-scales the chase: passive and Q/E move speed plus AoE R sleep let her dictate every late fight, so close the game before that comes online.
edits.after: She out-scales the chase: passive and Q/E move speed plus an AoE R sleep let her dictate when every late fight starts, so close the game before that.

edits.before: Your sore spot: still no Hallowed Mist, so a melee with no untargetability eats free Q poke and passive-DOT chip from a champ who outruns you. Hold even and wait for 6.
edits.after: Your sore spot: no Hallowed Mist yet, and Blooming Blows (Q, 6s) deals TRUE damage on its outer edge — MR will not save you on the rim. Hold even and wait for 6.

edits.before: Track Lillia's Blooming Blows: Her kite + move speed stacks. When it is down — Q-snip in the mist.
edits.after: Blooming Blows (Q, 6s) deals true damage on its EDGE — the rim is the danger zone, not the middle.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kite + move speed stacks. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lilting Lullaby (R): 150/130/110s — dodge it at 6 and the next 150 seconds are yours. - Blooming Blows (Q, 6s): true damage on the edge. - Swirlseed (E): a flat 12s, and it keeps rolling until it hits a wall.

edits.before: Land R sleep to set up a free DOT-stacked Q/W burst, or to disengage the instant you E onto her
edits.after: Land the 150-second Lilting Lullaby to set up a DOT-stacked burst, or to disengage the moment you E in

notes: Dream Dust stacking rules (how many hits are needed before Lilting Lullaby will sleep a target) are not in the kit file, so the R lines were kept general rather than given a stack count.
